name: Set and Forget on BTC and ETH 1H

history.reason: FAIL, rejected with Luke's say-so (2026-11-16). Fails test 1 on both coins, 1H 2020-01 to 2025-10: BTC +0.6% (Sharpe 0.04) against +12% for BTC held at the same exposure, 62 trades, +0.02R a trade, break-even 19 bps vs 17 (2x needed); ETH -6.2% (Sharpe -0.18) against +15%, 59 trades, -0.09R. Costs were small (0.06-0.07R): the mechanical version of the method has no edge before costs. Robustness not run (Luke).
